snippet.title: Pareicopse Trailer
snippet.description:
Pareicopse is a survival horror game made for the hps1 game jam. Search for your friend in the Pareicopse Woods while keeping your fear in check.
Download the game now at https://totinospizzaboy.itch.io/pareicopse
